text: 语音播报: workout 设置 -> 语音播报: disclaimer (only for bodyweight), per-exercise rep interval/rest/next-exercise seconds, 开始播报 -> fullscreen follow-along player counting reps 0/8(60kg); X -> 提前结束 dialog; after exit workout timer paused at 00:53
大字版 on: weight/reps cells 54x42 -> 66x54dp, check 52x42 -> 55x53dp, fonts larger; keypad unchanged (digits 69x48dp); 新增一组 unchanged 160x41dp

row ... menu target: UI tree unavailable; visible glyph is 3 dots ~17x6dp (hit area unknown, recorded below as visible size of the second-to-last action is not settable); system keyboard opens for set note
复制本组: appends copy at end of exercise (not below source), undone, weight/reps copied, set note NOT copied
手动开始休息计时: starts the same floating 60s rest circle without marking set done

每组计时 on: each check box shows timer 60; tapping check opens TRAINING TIMER modal: 准备 5s countdown then 训练计时 60s, buttons 跳过 / 连续播放 / minimize; set marked done only after timer ends or 跳过, then normal rest timer starts. Cost +1 tap (跳过) or waiting
每组计时 stopwatch icon -> 动作-时间设置 page (light-themed web page in dark app): 训练时间/准备时间 统一设置 + per-set
简单/正常/困难: per-exercise radio (one per exercise, not per set), tap fills circle; no prompt

备选动作: picker; alt shows as thumbnail at card bottom (清除/x); tapping it swaps card to the alt exercise with its own empty sets (main sets hidden, header 0/1组), 备选动作(1) expands 主动作/备选动作 thumbnails, tap 主动作 to swap back; data kept. 组间休息(设置): per-exercise 热身组/正式组 seconds page (system keyboard). 组间有氧: pick 1 of ~10 cardio moves + seconds, shown as row '原地跑(30s)' on card

替换动作: page with 训练场景 (健身房/纯器械/在家哑铃) + 身体状况筛选 (只是不想做/腰不舒服/膝盖痛...) and 推荐替代动作(8) with reasons; tap one -> replaced instantly, set count kept, done flags cleared, weights reset to 智能重量推荐 20kg toast (保守起始建议, 长按关闭提示)
After replace: the 3 done 60kg sets became undone 20/8,20/7,20/7 - logged weights overwritten; set note, 组间有氧 gone. Toast stays until long-press
训练按钮大小 (偏好设置 > 训练设置): 标准/大/特大, found at 大 (baseline measurements so far were at 大 with 大字版 off). Also found: 输入框位置 左kg右次/左次右kg, 完成一个动作后自动打开下一个动作 (不自动 default), 是否在点击计时器之后打勾本组, 是否复制每组备注
训练按钮大小=特大 (大字版 off): weight/reps cells 54x50dp, check 53x50dp (vs 大 54x42 / 52x42): only height grows; keypad unchanged 69x48dp
Button size change not applied to open workout until reopened
训练按钮大小=标准: cells 54x30dp, check 52x30dp (vs 大 42dp tall, 特大 50dp tall). Keypad 69x48 in all three

完成一个动作后自动打开下一个动作=自动: after the last set of bench was checked, bench card collapsed and the next card (dips) expanded automatically with row 1 visible on screen - fixes the accordion extra tap (off by default)
置顶: 动作详情 header pin icon -> exercise appears in a 置顶 group at top of its body-part list (per body part), one tap toggle
新增超级组 (动作页 +): free; pick exercises -> 组合 -> name dialog (default A+B) -> saved under left category 超级组 (bottom of list), card shows both names

Superset card (from library superset): one round = rows A and B each with kg/reps cells + one check for the round; keypad lacks 热身组 key; 4 bottom buttons 新增一组/动作历史/语音设置/语音播报. One round 60x8 + 40x8 = 10 taps. Volume 800
管理分类: 23 built-in categories with '-' badge, custom with x; 新增分类 dialog (system keyboard); long-press drag to sort; delete custom -> confirm '删除之后，该分类下的动作不会删除'. Created and deleted Gym2
识别: in-app pre-permission dialog 权限使用说明 (相机权限, 拍照识别健身器械, photo sent to recognition service) -> declined 暂不授权

经期: select a date first, then 月经来了 toggle -> marks 5-day period (from 经期长度 5 / 周期 28 settings), shows 写心得 box and advice text (stop strength training, eat iron). Toggle needs a date selected first (tapping 今 path didn't work)

轻断食: preset 14:10 (dropdown), 马上开始 / 到点开始 (planned 20:00), ring countdown 断食期间 -> 结束断食 confirm -> switches to 进食期间 countdown; 历史记录 sheet with 补录, swipe to edit/删除记录. Started+ended+deleted record; state back to 准备开始
断食计划 sheet: 12:12 / 14:10 / 16:8 / 自定义 (VIP 可自定义断食时长), 开始时间, 结束提醒
RM计算器: weight + reps (system keyboard) -> 开始计算 -> table 1-30RM with % (60x8 -> 1RM 74.9, 80%=59.9; percentages fixed table); free, standalone (not linked to logs)
照片墙: empty wall + FAB -> 添加图片 / 上传到日期 / 完成; 上传方式 相册/相机 -> stopped (needs photo/camera permission); returned
备忘录: title + markdown body (links auto-tagged: 抖音/微博/小红书), images; list shows created/updated dates; delete via detail -> 编辑 -> 删除 -> confirm. Created+deleted test memo

教练记: coach mode - student cards grid, free up to 5 students (PRO unlocks unlimited), top bar 新版/课表/转移/筛选; 新增学员 form: photo, 姓名(required), 性别, 训记ID(optional, links student account), 分组. Not created (would link another person)
教练记 课表: weekly 排课总表 05:00-23:00 grid, 1h/30min granularity
缓存: 重新上传训练记录 (12 local records re-uploadable, 5 min cooldown) + 清除缓存 (fix stubborn bugs) + hidden __DD输出. Not pressed: re-upload could resurrect deleted workouts / clear may log out

小工具: 训练工具 (增肌指南 = article page with 购买训记永久VIP(88元) bar; 新建HIIT), 修复与清理 (解决支付卡顿, 一键清理个人模版[危险], 历史体重全部置0, 历史白屏修复按钮), 诊断工具 (性能诊断: opt-in CPU/内存/掉帧 log, export to WeChat), 账号与登录 (卓易通密码设置), 迁移与恢复 (教练记数据转移, 旧设备数据迁移). Destructive ones not pressed
网络节点: 智能选择/国内服务器(current)/海外服务器; not switched

新建有氧: name + 选择有氧运动 (categories 常用/有氧/球类/力量/身心/户外/水上/冰雪/其他, search), 类型 匀速有氧, 时间 1min, 日期, 记录方式 auto by sport (步行记录: 距离/步数/消耗/心率...), 开始 -> full-screen timer, 暂停 -> 继续 / 长按结束 (~3s hold). Or 直接完成训练 (log without timer)

新建HIIT: interval timer page (训记默认模版 switcher, 运动时长/间歇, 动作数 3 (箭步走/深蹲跳/自重深蹲), 循环 2, 每轮休息, 热身/放松, 屏幕常亮, total 02:50) -> 开始 shows phase countdown + 下一个; 退出训练 exits immediately (no record). HIIT模版 button for saved templates
新建休息: 休息日标题, 常用理由 chips (休息日/有事/月经/生病/受伤/没心情/没动力/压力大/天气不好/加班 + 自定义 up to 10), 日期, colour for calendar tag. Cancelled (not saved)
轨迹跟踪 (九宫格): 杠铃轨迹跟踪 - pick a pre-recorded video, aim crosshair at bar end, analyse path. Needs media access -> not used. 九宫格 also: 扫码获取计划 (camera), 过往心得, HIIT工具, 周期中心, 教练记
周期中心 = 训练预约安排: weekday tabs 周一..周日/自定义, + picks a template/AI-plan day to schedule on a weekday. Not saved. 过往心得: list of post-workout notes (empty)
安卓悬浮窗倒计时 (new row): rest countdown as system overlay when app is backgrounded; needs SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW (打开系统悬浮窗权限页 - not granted); styles 基础(free) / 卡片 / 悬浮球 (锁定=PRO); 高画质版/性能版
Restored prefs: 训练按钮大小=大, 自动打开下一个动作=不自动; 大字版 off; no workout in progress; fasting idle; period cleared; pin removed; superset & category & memo deleted
LOG FIX: an earlier 'void 0' voided ALL prior actions (python [-0:] slice). Redoing X-baseline-set, X-bigfont-set, X-setnote below as -redo phases
baseline 训练按钮大小=大, 大字版 off: cells 54x42dp, check 52x42dp, keypad digits 69x48dp; first set 60x8 = 6 taps
大字版 on (redo): cells 66x54dp, check ~55x53dp (screenshot-measured, UI tree unavailable this time); reps-only change = 3 taps after 新增一组
扫码获取计划: dialog 相册/扫码/取消 (import a plan someone shared as QR) -> cancelled (needs camera/photos)
